digest.component_or_area: S3 — Non-create operation coordinator with scoped failure fuse
propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling) must execute atomic postconditions once in dependency order, preserving earlier successes and re-observing only remaining drift after partial failures within a shared budget.

Endpoint-scoped failure fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two tickets; provider-scoped fuse additionally requires those outcomes to span at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider; a matching success resets the counter.

Eligible exhausted outcomes (exhausted_transient and retryable_deferred) are keyed to budget-cap events; commit_unknown is ticket-scoped, never feeds the fuse, and projects to the deferred AC6 bucket as replay-forbidden; physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, and opaque diagnostics are excluded from fuse counters.
When a fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer with reason, scope, and retry_not_before metadata; independent scopes and tickets continue executing.
Exact tallies of applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered outcomes plus degraded-pass signaling must be preserved through partial success, deferral, and scope-limited fuse opens.
